picks.editorial_note: At up to $38M, this ARPA-H award is the largest research grant in UVM's history and funds AI 'digital twins' that could personalize critical care for patients in real time.
picks.title: Your AI Twin Could Save Your Life: UVM Awarded up to $38M…

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech and Amazon are formalizing a decade of collaboration into a dedicated science hub, signaling deepening structural ties between big tech and academic AI research.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Amazon Launch Joint Science Hub

picks.editorial_note: Harvard's $150M self-funded research initiative, one of its largest-ever direct investments, shows a major university betting its own balance sheet on AI-adjacent science amid federal funding uncertainty.
picks.title: Harvard launches $150 million research initiative— Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: An international study using a real xAI gas-turbine data center as its case study quantifies how AI's power demand is straining grids and risking a fossil-fuel resurgence, a central policy fight for AI infrastructure.
picks.title: AI Data Centers: A Challenge for the Power Grid

picks.editorial_note: MIT used AI to design heat-stable RNA vaccine formulations that last a year at room temperature, a breakthrough with direct implications for vaccine distribution in low-resource settings.
picks.title: New formulation helps RNA vaccines withstand high temperatures

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's open-source Tessera model maps smallholder crops in Senegal more accurately than existing tools while using far less compute, demonstrating real-world AI impact in global food security.
picks.title: AI tool for mapping smallholder crops proves itself in Senegal

picks.editorial_note: WashU's audit found Google AI Overviews appear in 13.7% of searches with roughly 11% of claims unsupported or contradicted by their own sources, a consequential finding on AI-driven misinformation at massive scale.
picks.title: WashU research finds gaps in Google AI Overview citations, claims

picks.editorial_note: Brown engineers built a retina-inspired imaging system that can see through fog, a notable advance in sensing that could improve autonomous vehicles and surveillance in poor visibility.
picks.title: Brown University engineers build brain-inspired imaging system that can ‘see’ through fog

picks.editorial_note: UW-Madison's AI-driven tools generate individualized 'brain roadmaps' linking cellular and genetic changes to Alzheimer's progression, advancing precision approaches to a disease with no cure.
picks.title: ‘We built a brain roadmap for each person’: New AI-driven tools help decode Alzheimer’s disease at the cellular level

picks.editorial_note: A $4.25M DARPA grant to a WashU-led multi-institutional team pairs AI with physics-based simulation to redesign fuel injectors, illustrating government-funded AI adoption in defense-relevant engineering.
picks.title: WashU-led team wins $4M DARPA grant to improve fuel injector design
